title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium on 1978-04-12
source: Source: SBD Master Reel (7" two track @ 7 1/2 ips - recorded by Betty Cantor) > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz - Provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16-bit/44.1k - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick April 2018

ai_review.summary: Tasty‑sounding soundboard recording captures a high‑energy 1978 performance highlighted by a smoking “Loser”.
ai_review.review: The three five‑star reviews rave about crystal‑clear separation and definition, marking this as an excellent soundboard capture. Musically the show is described as vibrant – Keith’s keyboards still have vitality, Jerry’s voice is strong, and the band pushes the music to eleven, with “Loser” singled out as a must‑hear highlight.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 5 stars and praised both the audio fidelity and the performance, indicating an exceptional show with excellent recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tasty sounding, great definition, nice separation; no reported issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy, era‑defining performance with the band pushing dynamics to the max; flow described as consistently strong throughout.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith still showing vitality on keyboards.
